:::caution
This rule is part of the [nursery](/linter/#nursery) group. This means that it is experimental and the behavior can change at any time.
:::
## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.5`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noAwaitInPromiseMethods`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule has an [**unsafe**](/linter/#unsafe-fixes) fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**warning**](/reference/diagnostics#warning).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`unicorn/no-await-in-promise-methods`](https://github.com/sindresorhus/eslint-plugin-unicorn/blob/main/docs/rules/no-await-in-promise-methods.md)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noAwaitInPromiseMethods": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow using `await` inside the array passed to `Promise.all()`, `Promise.allSettled()`, `Promise.any()`, or `Promise.race()`.

These methods wait for several promises at the same time.
Using `await` while building the array pauses the code until that promise finishes.
The rest of the array, and the method call itself, can only run after that,
so the promises no longer run at the same time.

If an element needs an awaited value, move the `await` into an async function and call it right away,
or use `.then()`. Both create a promise without pausing the code.

## Examples

### Invalid

```js
Promise.all([await promise, anotherPromise]);
```

### Valid

```js
Promise.all([promise, anotherPromise]);
Promise.allSettled([promise.then((value) => value.foo), anotherPromise]);
Promise.any([(async () => (await fetch(url)).json())(), anotherPromise]);
```
